name: Eric
source:
Yu-Qing's classmate. He good at playing flute and piano.

Though Eric has a special family, he is a tender and strong boy.

"You think we could make friends as long as you take pity on me, right...?"

[Edited from [url=http://www.erotes-studio.com/MayJasmine_english/03.html]official website[/url]]
